A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electron-beam irradiated blends containing reactive agents are useful to improve the compatibility and mechanical properties of immiscible polymer blends.
the compatibilized PA/PP blend irradiated at a dose of 200 kGys showed the best properties.

The main takeaway from our work is that
electron-beam treatment in the presence of a reactive agent can be used to compatibilize immiscible polymer blends.
the compatibilizing effect of electron beam treatment on immiscible PA6/PP blend in the presence of a reactive agent is effective.
